information.description:
SWAT on street patrol, rarely in quiet areas. A squad can turn up before MAX-TAC does.

NCPD: Night City's police, from beat cops to SWAT.

Stat block from Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis, unofficial content under R. Talsorian Games' Homebrew Content Policy. Portrait: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.
information.notes:
Threat: Hardened Lieutenant • Reputation: 2 • Facedown #: 6 • COM#: 13 • Role: Enforcer: Officer 4 (Authority 3 ⦁ Commando 1)

Enforcer: When interacting with other NCPD members they have some level of seniority over, Heavy Patrol Officers gain a +3 bonus to Acting, Bribery, Conversation, Interrogation, and Persuasion Skill Checks against them. Can use Combat Awareness as if they had 2 Ranks in Solo, but only for Damage Deflection, Precision Attack, and Threat Detection.

With gear or role bonuses: Brawling 13 (11), Evasion 13 (11), Stealth 8 (6)

Melee SP (head/body): 6/6
